Definition: Chasmonah, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Hashmonah shows up only as a stop on the wilderness march, named twice as Israel pitches there and then moves on to Moseroth. The name means fatness, but the text gives no story about the place, only its place in the long list of camps.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God counts the unremarkable stops too. Hashmonah has no event attached to it, yet it is written down, and that tells me no stage of the journey is forgotten by Him.
